offering_description.value: SPS Commerce sells cloud software to suppliers, retailers, distributors, and marketplace sellers. Its network connects trading partners so they can exchange orders, shipping notices, and invoices and share product and sales data. It also provides tools to recover retail deductions and marketplace reimbursements.

primary_products.value: Electronic data interchange and order fulfillment software; retail sales and inventory analytics; product catalog data software; retail deduction recovery software; marketplace seller tools

primary_services.value: Managed electronic data interchange; software implementation and integration; trading partner onboarding

customer_segment.value: B2B: Suppliers, consumer goods brands, manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and online marketplace sellers

end_markets.value: Retail; consumer goods; wholesale distribution; e-commerce marketplaces

revenue_model.value: subscription: Recurring access to cloud software for trading partner transactions, analytics, and revenue recovery; service fees: One-time setup, integration, and professional services

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: Processes orders, shipments, invoices, and sales data for suppliers, retailers, distributors, and marketplace sellers; service provider: Configures trading partner connections and manages electronic document exchange for suppliers and retailers

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: Retail document exchange, order fulfillment, sales analytics, product data, deduction recovery, and marketplace seller tools

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving suppliers, retailers, and other trading partners; partners / resellers: Retailer onboarding programs and integrations with business software providers; online: Web-based enrollment and onboarding for suppliers and marketplace sellers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Data protection requirements such as GDPR and country-specific electronic invoicing rules

notes: The current scope of the marketplace seller tools is uncertain.
